# references

Material for the heat-flow project (demo data: every name, link and paper below is made up).

## Project links
- [Course page: Heat transfer lab](https://example.edu/heat-lab) — the brief, the schedule and the grading sheet. (verified)
- [Lab safety sheet](https://example.edu/heat-lab/safety) — heater limits and the bench rules. (verified)
- [Sensor data sheet](https://example.com/sensors/tc-k) — type-K thermocouple accuracy and response time. (unverified)
- [Open thermal data set](https://example.org/thermal-data) — rod and fin measurements to compare against. (unverified)

## Earlier projects
No report from earlier years was found online (searched 2027-01-04). We ask the course staff at the first meeting.

## Notation
We write the fin parameter as $m^2 = hP/(kA)$, as in the 2021 rod paper. The steady profile is then
$$T(x) = T_\infty + (T_0 - T_\infty)\,\frac{\cosh m(L - x)}{\cosh mL}.$$
Our paper notes are in [notes/](notes/).

## Tools
- [Finite-difference notes](https://example.org/fd-notes) — how to discretise the heat equation on a grid, with a stability rule. (verified)
- [Plotting style guide](https://example.com/plot-guide) — axis labels, units and colour-blind-safe palettes. (verified)
